title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an iterative optimization algorithm used to find the minimum of a function. It updates parameters by moving in the direction of the negative gradient. What do you think happens if the learning rate is too high or too low?

title: Convergence of Gradient Descent
text: Convergence in gradient descent depends on several factors, including the learning rate and the nature of the function being minimized. Consider how these factors might affect whether the algorithm reaches a local or global minimum.

hintAnswer: It may overshoot the minimum and fail to converge.
